_comment: Screenshot checklist for tools/manual/capture.py. setup/teardown are console commands; prompt is shown to the operator before the capture. Files land in docs/manual/captures/<id>.png; the manual's build uses a mockup with a 'capture pending' caption while a file is missing.

captures.title: Default sweep screen, four traces
captures.prompt: Nothing connected to CH0 or CH1 (open ports); calibration ON (C0). Leave the menu closed.

captures.title: Status column with calibration letters and P/s indicators
captures.prompt: Same as before; the status column should show C0 D R S T X, Pa and s2.

captures.title: OPEN standard on a Smith chart
captures.prompt: Connect the OPEN standard to CH0 (calibration ON).

captures.title: SHORT standard on a Smith chart
captures.prompt: Connect the SHORT standard to CH0.

captures.title: LOAD standard, S11 LOGMAG
captures.prompt: Connect the LOAD standard to CH0.

captures.title: Calibrated THRU: S21 LOGMAG and PHASE
captures.prompt: Connect the THRU jumper CH0 -> CH1.

captures.title: Antenna: SWR and SWR ANT
captures.prompt: Connect the antenna through its feedline to CH0; set DISPLAY -> FORMAT -> CABLE LOSS (or CABLE TYPE + LENGTH) on the device; put marker 1 on the dip.

captures.title: MEASURE -> SWR BW panel on the antenna dip
captures.prompt: Same antenna; open MEASURE -> SWR BW (S11) on the device (the console 'measure' list predates it), marker 1 on the dip.

captures.title: MEASURE -> RESONANCE panel
captures.prompt: Same antenna, REACTANCE trace showing the zero crossing.

captures.title: Two markers with the delta readout
captures.prompt: Move marker 2 away from marker 1 with the wheel so the delta line shows.

captures.title: Top-level menu open
captures.prompt: Push the jog wheel once to open the menu.

captures.title: Frequency keypad
captures.prompt: STIMULUS -> START, leave the keypad open with a few digits typed.

captures.title: SD browser listing .s1p files
captures.prompt: SD CARD -> LOAD -> LOAD S1P (card with a few files inserted).

captures.title: Time-domain transform of an open cable
captures.prompt: Connect an open-ended cable to CH0; DISPLAY -> TRANSFORM on, LOW PASS IMPULSE, sweep from 50 kHz.
